packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/__init__.name: Voice package
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/__init__.description: Marks the voice code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/barge_in.name: Interrupt handling
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/barge_in.description: Handles the owner speaking over the agent, without cancelling the agent's real work.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/context..name: Voice context
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/context..description: Builds the bounded context about the chosen agent and conversation for a voice call.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/handoff..name: Transcript window
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/handoff..description: Keeps a bounded, non-overlapping window of the live transcript.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/incoming.name: Incoming calls
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/incoming.description: Handles a call coming in to the owner: the reach-me rule, ringing, answering, declining and logging it in the conversation.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/realtime.name: Live voice session
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/realtime.description: Runs the live voice link: the microphone stays on the direct connection while the agent's tools stay in Lonora.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/routing..name: Voice routing
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/routing..description: Picks the live voice model and route for a call.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/sessions.name: Voice sessions
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/sessions.description: Starts and ends a voice session, links an answered incoming call, and logs the call in the conversation.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/transcri.name: Save transcript
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/transcri.description: Saves a finished voice transcript as a message in the conversation.

packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/voice_no.name: Voice-note transcription
packages/voice/src/lonora_voice/voice_no.description: Turns the owner's voice notes into text in the background, in the owner's language.
